verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents Cortex Analyst, which lets business users ask natural-language questions and get direct answers without writing SQL. It also documents Semantic Views, which store business metrics, entities and their relationships as schema-level objects, and the managed MCP server can expose Cortex Analyst as a tool to agents. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that Cortex Analyst answers are grounded in Semantic Views and enforce RBAC governance, evidence of accuracy versus hallucinated joins, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
